publisher: USAspending.gov, U.S. Department of the Treasury
underlying_award_report_source: Agency-reported FPDS procurement data republished by USAspending; original contracting instrument not independently custodied

publisher_scope.source_reporting_lag: POSSIBLE; USAspending documentation says FPDS-derived contract data may lag, including special agency delays

synthetic_controls.invalid_candidate_claim: A public award page ending in 2027 proves an FY2027 SAM opportunity
synthetic_controls.unmet_proof: No SAM FY2027 notice identity, original notice bytes, or preaward source-asof evidence

synthetic_controls.invalid_candidate_claim: A displayed $0 outlay proves the separately reported award does not exist
synthetic_controls.unmet_proof: Official award page reports a nonzero obligation and PIID; outlay and obligation are distinct

synthetic_controls.invalid_candidate_claim: A procurement instrument identifier alone is an original solicitation number
synthetic_controls.unmet_proof: No first-party SAM notice ID or solicitation crosswalk

synthetic_controls.invalid_candidate_claim: Awarded/obligated dollars prove recipient bank settlement
synthetic_controls.unmet_proof: No independently verified bank clearing or customer recovery evidence

synthetic_controls.invalid_candidate_claim: Period-of-performance start is the signed contract award date
synthetic_controls.unmet_proof: Award-signature timestamp is not verified from publisher page

synthetic_controls.invalid_candidate_claim: A later public page proves what was visible before contract award
synthetic_controls.unmet_proof: No original time-stamped SAM pre-award snapshot or prior publisher source bytes

synthetic_controls.invalid_candidate_claim: Missing join or unreported award is a negative award-outcome label
synthetic_controls.unmet_proof: Reporting delays, suppressed data, absent crosswalk, and completeness UNKNOWN

synthetic_controls.invalid_candidate_claim: Two USAspending award pages provide independent-publisher confirmation
synthetic_controls.unmet_proof: Both pages are the same Treasury/FPDS reporting chain

quality_and_dedup.canonical_identity: Publisher award unique key (PIID alone is not globally unique)
quality_and_dedup.effective_date_policy: The published period-of-performance start/end is NOT a verified contract signature date or SAM original-posted timestamp

handoffs.capturebrief_52: Keep FY2027 archived notice as-of extraction separate from USAspending FPDS-derived award metadata; require original notice and observed-as-of proof plus disambiguated solicitation/agency crosswalk and independent adjudication before scoring.
handoffs.retally_recoveryos_12: Obligated and outlayed federal accounting figures are not buyer bank-cleared recovery cash; NO_CUSTOMER_CASH_PROVED
handoffs.independent_QA_44: Verify both official source pages, indexed-data freshness limits, exact fixture and test SHA, two real source-reported records versus eight SYNTHETIC controls, no award truth or release.
